shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

notes: «ح» splits two routes; they meet at Amr (the first route's «عن عمرو» and the second's «عن عمرو بن دينار»), and the names the text writes once after that meeting form the shared tail.
«قال محمد في حديثه وكلتا يديه يمين» is a pure wording variant: left out.
The Prophet is the end of the chain and is not written.
